name: Menorca Airport

runway.v: One runway, 01/19, 2,550 m × 45 m (last 200 m of RWY 01 not usable; RWY 19 threshold displaced 200 m)

hours.v: Airport open winter 06:00–21:00 UTC (07:00–22:00 local), summer 05:00–22:30 UTC (07:00–00:30 local); can be extended 45 min (winter) or 25 min (summer) with PPR

curfew.v: Airport closed outside its hours: winter closed 22:00–07:00 local (21:00–06:00 UTC); summer closed 00:30–07:00 local (22:30–05:00 UTC); short extension possible with PPR

customs.v: Customs and immigration during airport hours only

ppr.v: Opening extension after hours needs PPR

handling.v: Handling agent mandatory for all general and business aviation
handling.quote: It is mandatory for all General and Business aviation operations to require the services of a ground handling agent.

fuel.v: Jet A-1 and 100LL during airport hours

noise.v: Reverse thrust above idle not allowed except for safety
noise.quote: Reverse power other than idle is not allowed, except for safety reasons.

notes: Read AIP España AD 2-LEMH (HTML, AIRAC AMDT 09/26, WEF 01 Oct 2026 and AMDT 405/26). Not H24: winter hours 07:00–22:00 local, customs the same (hours_local given for winter). Hours are UTC in the AIP. Slot rule not stated on the page.
